label.text:
A modchart is a list of events. Each event changes one modifier of one target over time.

Targets: the player strumline, the opponent strumline, both of them, the HUD camera and the game camera.

Modifiers move, rotate and fade the receptors and the notes, make them sway (drunk, tipsy, wobble) or move and zoom the cameras.

An event with a length of 0 jumps to its value. A longer event eases from the value the modifier had to the new one.

Save writes the modchart to your data folder and the game uses it for that song. Turn modcharts off in Preferences if the movement bothers you.

More modifiers: Scale, Spin, Flip and Invert the lanes, Beat bounce, Bumpy notes and Note opacity for the strumlines, Shake and Beat pulse for the cameras. Edit has Repeat Selection (for example 8 every 1 copies the selection 8 times, 1 beat apart) and Mirror to the Other Strumline.

Modchart files can also be written by hand with beats, repeats and macros. Saving from the editor writes them as plain events.
